# Assessments

The course is letter graded. Category weights are TBD. Four things are required of
everyone.

| Requirement | What it means | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly attendance | Be in the room each week. Absence policy TBD. | TBD |
| Weekly update email | An end-of-week update sent to the person you report to, CC strategy-program@byu.edu. Twelve total. See [Weekly Updates](03-weekly-updates.qmd). | TBD |
| Peer feedback | Give and receive structured feedback with the other leaders during the roundtable. | TBD |
| AI proficiency | Demonstrate working proficiency with AI tools. Requires a paid Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus subscription, $20 per month, maintained all semester. Bar and evidence TBD. | TBD |

## Weekly Update Emails

Twelve updates, due Thursday by 11:59 PM. Every student in the Lab sends one, to the person
directly above them in the program, with `strategy-program@byu.edu` in CC. The CC is how
completion is tracked, so an update without it does not count.

| Status | Credit |
|---|---|
| On time, Thursday by 11:59 PM | Full |
| Late, by Friday 12:30 PM | Half |
| After class starts | None |

The reporting table, format, and an example are on the
[Weekly Updates](03-weekly-updates.qmd) page.

Because student employees are paid for their leadership work, class sessions and
class-specific assignments are not billable hours. Keep the two separate on your timesheet.
